name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or improvement
title: "[Feature] Brief, descriptive title"

## Problem
What user problem does this solve?

## Proposal
Describe the solution. Include example pages, components, or configuration changes.

## Alternatives
Other approaches considered and why this approach is preferred.

## Additional Context
Links, references, or mockups. If visual, include screenshots.

## Verification Steps
How should reviewers test it locally? (e.g., `jekyll serve --baseurl ''` and visit affected pages.)
